excerpt: A new fixed-target experiment at the CERN SPS accelerator is proposed that will use decays of charm mesons to search for Heavy Neutral Leptons (HNLs), which are right-handed partners of the Standard Model neutrinos.
publisher: W. Bonivento et al. / CERN SPS and PS Experiments Committee (SPSC)
title: Proposal to Search for Heavy Neutral Leptons at the SPS (CERN-SPSC-2013-024 / SPSC-EOI-010)
